Plotly.js gl2d partial bundle v3.6.0, MIT licence.
Vendored from https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-gl2d-3.6.0.min.js so the site has no
runtime dependency on an external CDN. Contains scattergl (WebGL scatter) and
layout.images; deliberately not the full bundle, which is 1,427 KB gzipped
against this one at 517 KB.
